resources.string: Receives NEXT / PREVIOUS / PLAY_PAUSE from your laptop over Wi-Fi and performs the matching swipe or tap.
Performs swipe/tap gestures requested by your paired laptop.

Reel Remote uses this service only to perform three gestures — swipe up, swipe down and a single tap — when your paired laptop asks for them. It does not read screen content and does not collect any data.
Android only lets an app perform touch gestures through an accessibility service. Turn on “Reel Remote gestures” under Installed apps / Downloaded apps.
Type this into the laptop controller. Anyone on your Wi-Fi who knows it can send the three commands, so treat it like a password. Regenerating it immediately locks out the old one.
All values are percentages of the screen, so they work on any resolution. NEXT swipes from “Start Y” up to “End Y”; PREVIOUS is the reverse.
Only act while Instagram is the foreground app
No Wi-Fi address — connect the phone to your Wi-Fi network
Enable the accessibility service before starting the server.
This app never reads screen content, never talks to the internet, and only ever performs the three gestures listed above.
